question: Rohan Bopanna and Ramkumar Ramanathan got direct entry into the doubles main draw of the fourth edition of which of the following tennis tournaments starting in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tata Open Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohan Bopanna and Ramkumar Ramanathan** received direct entry into the doubles main draw of the** fourth edition **of the **Maharashtra Open tennis tournament,** which began in** January 2022.**
 
• The Maharashtra Open is an **ATP Tour 250 tournament **held annually in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
 
• It is one of the prominent tennis tournaments in India and attracts top players from around the world.
 
• As part of their preparations for the tournament, Bopanna and Ramanathan were granted direct entry into the doubles main draw, indicating their strong standing in the doubles category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Direct entry into the main draw means that they did not have to go through the qualifying rounds **to secure a place in the tournament**.
 
• Instead, their ranking and past performances earned them **direct placement** in the main draw, allowing them to compete directly against other top doubles teams in the tournament.
 
• This is a testament to their skill and achievements in the world of tennis.
